items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Four lines in the same style as the surrounding code. The comment explains the non-obvious reason: '# parse_url doesn't provide the netloc with auth / so we'll add it ourselves.'

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Small change inside prepend_scheme_if_needed that reuses the auth value parse_url already returns. No new helpers, no duplicated logic, no dead code or debug output.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The agent's own probe [32] found that 'http://user:pass@' now raises TypeError in '@'.join([auth, netloc]) because netloc is None; before the change it returned the URL. The agent left this unguarded (the reference has the same gap).

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
